subject: infra.cybersec
name: National Computer Incident Response Team
what_would_settle_it: The full Project Appraisal Document's component text, which would state whether a national response team is funded, hosted or operating; the wiki holds only the datasheet and strategic context paragraphs

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Central Monitoring Centre
what_would_settle_it: The text of the Cyber Security Act No. 3 of 2025 and any commencement or establishment order; the base carries the Centre only as an embassy and civil-society characterisation, with no evidence it has been built, sited, staffed or funded

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National cybersecurity policy or strategy
what_would_settle_it: A published national cybersecurity strategy or the critical-information-infrastructure designation list required under the 2025 Act

subject: infra.store
name: Government cloud and data-hosting arrangements
what_would_settle_it: The state ICT institute's hosting policy or a government cloud contract stating where ministry data and the portal and service-bus workloads physically reside

subject: infra.capacity
name: International transit and wholesale bandwidth pricing
what_would_settle_it: The regulator's annual market performance report for a year after 2022, or an operator's published wholesale tariff; the last market report the wiki holds is for 2022

subject: infra.energy
name: Power supply and backup at telecommunications sites
what_would_settle_it: An operator or regulator statement of site electrification, generator and battery coverage, or reported outage hours attributable to grid failure

subject: infra.energy
name: Electricity supply to data centres
what_would_settle_it: A utility or facility-operator statement of contracted load and backup arrangements for the national data centre and any commercial facility

subject: infra.connect
name: Satellite operator licence terms in Zambia
what_would_settle_it: The regulator's licence award notice or fee schedule for satellite service providers; the held market report gives a continental fee range but no Zambian figure

subject: infra.connect
name: 4G and mobile broadband population coverage
what_would_settle_it: A regulator coverage report by technology; the government's 92% and 94% coverage claims state no unit or measurement basis

subject: infra.connect
name: Fixed and mobile broadband pricing
what_would_settle_it: A price basket after the 2025 appraisal's statement that 5 GB of fixed broadband costs more than 12% of gross national income per head; no post-2025 Zambian tariff figure is held

subject: dpi.id
name: System integrator contract award for the digital ID
what_would_settle_it: The procurement award notice naming the integrator, contract value and delivery dates; the base holds the March 2026 procurement opening and nothing after it

subject: dpi.id
name: Outcome of the April 2025 mobile campaign for 3.5 million ID documents
what_would_settle_it: A registration department or home affairs ministry closing report for the three-month campaign, giving registration cards and birth certificates actually issued

subject: dpi.id
name: Refugee biometric registration card issuance
what_would_settle_it: The refugee and host communities project implementation status report, which would show disbursement and whether biometric registration under the identity subcomponent has begun

subject: dpi.pay
name: Central bank national payment system statistics
what_would_settle_it: A national payment systems annual or quarterly report giving mobile money and switch transaction volumes and values; the base carries only inclusion rates quoted second-hand

subject: digital.localgov
name: Whether the seven pilot councils went live on the national portal by 2026-06-30
what_would_settle_it: A local government ministry statement after 2026-06-30 listing councils live on the portal

subject: data.statistics
name: Regulator annual or quarterly market performance report after 2022
what_would_settle_it: A market performance report for 2023 or later; the only one held is the 2022 edition

subject: data.satellite
name: A national earth-observation or satellite-data programme
what_would_settle_it: A Zambian space or earth-observation policy, a national satellite data agreement, or the spatial data portal's dataset inventory naming its imagery sources

subject: gov.protect
name: Data Protection Act statutory instruments and regulations
what_would_settle_it: The Government Gazette carrying the Act's commencement order and any statutory instruments made under it on registration of controllers, transfer rules and breach notification

subject: gov.protect
name: Data protection regulator enforcement record
what_would_settle_it: The Office's annual report or a published register of controllers, complaints, breach notifications and enforcement decisions

subject: gov.protect
name: Cabinet decision to repeal and replace the Data Protection Act 2021
what_would_settle_it: The Cabinet decision or the gazetted amendment or repeal Bill; the base carries only a civil-society report's statement of intent, current to late 2025

subject: gov.legislate
name: Cyber Security Act No. 3 of 2025, statutory text
what_would_settle_it: The gazetted text of the Act, which would establish whether the interception mandate and central monitoring centre attributed to it are provisions of the Act

subject: gov.legislate
name: Enforcement outturn under the Cyber Crimes Act No. 4 of 2025
what_would_settle_it: Charge, prosecution or conviction figures from the National Prosecution Authority or the Judiciary, or a ministerial statement to the National Assembly giving counts since 2026-07-18

subject: gov.legislate
name: Access to information law
what_would_settle_it: A gazetted Access to Information Act or Bill; no held source states whether Zambia has one, and the base carries no position at any date

subject: gov.regional
name: Ratification of the AU Malabo Convention
what_would_settle_it: The African Union list of signatures, ratifications and accessions, or a Zambian instrument of ratification

subject: gov.discourse
name: Parliamentary and public contestation of Zambia's data governance
what_would_settle_it: Hansard for the sittings at which the cyber Acts and the data protection Act were debated; the base holds two sources on this subject and one is a paywalled lede

subject: data.open
name: National open data portal and open data policy
what_would_settle_it: A government open-data portal with a dataset inventory and licence terms, or a Cabinet-approved open data policy; the base holds only the geospatial portal

subject: geopol.eu
name: EU-Zambia digital cooperation
what_would_settle_it: A European Commission or EU Delegation announcement, Global Gateway project fiche or financing agreement naming a Zambian digital investment; the base holds zero Zambia sources on this subject

subject: geopol.eu
name: Legal basis for personal-data transfers between Zambia and the EU
what_would_settle_it: A European Commission adequacy decision, or a Zambian data protection determination or guidance on cross-border transfer mechanisms

subject: geopol.gulf
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Any Gulf-state technology engagement with Zambia
what_would_settle_it: A bilateral agreement, investment record or ministerial visit involving the UAE, Saudi Arabia or Qatar; nothing on file, the base holding zero Zambia sources on this subject

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Artificial intelligence budget line or implementation costing
what_would_settle_it: The 2026 or 2027 national budget estimates showing an AI allocation, or a costed implementation plan annexed to the strategy

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: National artificial intelligence institution or agency
what_would_settle_it: A statutory instrument or cabinet decision establishing a Zambian AI body; nothing names one, and the only institution on offer is the proposed international lab

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: National artificial intelligence compute inventory
what_would_settle_it: A state ICT institute or ministry statement of installed government compute, or the technical annex to the vendor memorandum

subject: tech.innovate
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Government innovation or venture fund
what_would_settle_it: A budget line, fund charter or disbursement record; the base holds no Zambian public innovation fund of any kind

subject: tech.innovate
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Technology hub inventory
what_would_settle_it: A directory or count of Zambian innovation hubs; one hub is named anywhere in the base, and long-standing hubs appear nowhere in it

subject: tech.innovate
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Zambian startup funding totals
what_would_settle_it: The underlying diversity report, or an African startup funding report with a Zambia line; only continental aggregates are held

subject: tech.industry
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: ICT sector contribution to GDP
what_would_settle_it: A statistics agency national-accounts release with an ICT sector share; the Presidential Delivery Unit called ICT one of Zambia's fastest-growing sectors with no figure behind it

subject: finance.budget
name: Ministry of Technology and Science annual appropriation
what_would_settle_it: Zambia's Estimates of Revenue and Expenditure for FY2025 and FY2026, head-level lines for the technology ministry and the state ICT institute; there is no domestic budget archive for Zambia

subject: finance.budget
name: Universal Access and Service Fund accounts
what_would_settle_it: The regulator's annual report or the fund's own audited financial statements, giving the levy rate, fund balance and annual disbursement

subject: finance.budget
name: State ICT institute appropriation and project counterpart funding
what_would_settle_it: The acceleration project financing agreement or the estimates line showing the government's counterpart contribution against the US$100 million grant

subject: capacity.literacy
name: National digital literacy rate or programme
what_would_settle_it: A regulator or statistics agency ICT household survey reporting digital skills prevalence, or a named national digital-literacy curriculum document

subject: capacity.training
name: Digital skills targets under the e-Government Plan 2023-2026
what_would_settle_it: The plan itself, which the hub names but no held source reproduces or quantifies

subject: include.divides
name: Gender gap in internet use or mobile ownership
what_would_settle_it: An industry association gender-gap country figure or a regulator or statistics agency survey disaggregating internet use by sex

subject: include.divides
name: Rural-urban internet use split
what_would_settle_it: A regulator market report or household survey disaggregating internet use by residence; the base gives only that 52.4% of the population is rural

subject: include.access
name: Device affordability and data cost as a share of income
what_would_settle_it: An affordability alliance or ITU affordability figure for Zambia; the base holds only the appraisal statement that fixed broadband exceeds 12% of gross national income per head

subject: include.access
name: Digital access for persons with disabilities
what_would_settle_it: A national disability-inclusion policy or regulator programme document; the base holds only individual ICT donations to two special schools
